<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AILA Admin Panel</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/styles/github-dark.min.css">
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/highlight.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        :root {
            --accent: #00ff88;
            --accent-dim: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.3);
            --bg-dark: #0a0a0f;
            --bg-card: #12121a;
            --bg-card-hover: #1a1a25;
            --text-primary: #e5e7eb;
            --text-secondary: #9ca3af;
            --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            --blue: #3b82f6;
            --blue-dim: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
            --red: #ef4444;
            --yellow: #fbbf24;
        }
        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        body {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
            height: 100vh;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
        }
        .accent { color: var(--accent); }
        .text-dim { color: var(--text-secondary); }

        /* Auth modal */
        .auth-overlay {
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            z-index: 9999;
        }
        .auth-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 32px;
            width: 360px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .auth-box h2 { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 1.5rem; }
        .auth-box .subtitle { color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .auth-input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 14px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            text-align: center;
            letter-spacing: 8px;
            outline: none;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        .auth-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
        .auth-input::placeholder { letter-spacing: normal; font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .auth-btn {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 14px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }
        .auth-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #000; }
        .auth-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-dim); }
        .auth-btn-ghost {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 10px;
        }
        .auth-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
        .auth-error { color: var(--red); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 8px; display: none; }
        .auth-timer { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 8px; display: none; }

        /* Layout */
        .admin-layout {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
